item.title: Walz Announces $8 Billion Grant To Somali Company To Investigate Fraud
item.description: ST. PAUL, MN — In response to growing allegations of fraud tied to Minnesota's Somali community, Governor Tim Walz announced he had awarded an $8 billion grant to a Somali company to find the perpetrators.
